name: x402bench-agentic-payments
description: Benchmark suite for LLM payment-workflow readiness with Hedera, Chainlink, and Ledger policy controls.

scripts.readiness:bench: node scripts/run_llm_readiness_benchmark.mjs --config config/benchmark.config.json --suite readiness_bench/suite.json --runtime ollama --models qwen3:4b-instruct,phi4:14b,gemma3:12b-it-qat,qwen2.5:0.5b,gemma4:e4b --outdir readiness_bench/results
scripts.readiness:bench:wide: node scripts/run_llm_readiness_benchmark.mjs --config config/benchmark.config.json --suite readiness_bench/suite.json --runtime ollama --models qwen3:4b-instruct,phi4:14b,gemma3:12b-it-qat,deepseek-r1:14b,qwen2.5:0.5b,gemma4:e4b --outdir readiness_bench/results
scripts.readiness:bench:hf: node scripts/run_llm_readiness_benchmark.mjs --config config/benchmark.config.json --suite readiness_bench/suite.json --runtime openai_compat --api-base-url https://router.huggingface.co/v1 --api-key-env HF_TOKEN --models Qwen/Qwen3-4B-Instruct,google/gemma-3-4b-it --outdir readiness_bench/results
